zh: 单词之间互不影响，可以逐个单词独立判断；判断时大小写视为同一个字母，所以先把字母统一成小写（或大写）再计数。
对每个单词用长度为 26 的计数数组统计各字母出现次数；只要某个字母的次数达到 3，这个单词就符合条件，而且只算一次，不按满足条件的字母个数重复计。
按空白把输入切成单词，答案置 0；对每个单词清空计数数组，逐字符转小写后计数，一旦某个计数达到 3 就标记命中；命中则答案加一。最后输出答案。
en: Words do not affect each other, so each word can be judged independently; upper and lower case count as the same letter, so normalize every letter to lower (or upper) case before counting.
For each word, count letters in an array of size 26; as soon as some letter reaches 3 occurrences the word qualifies, and it is counted only once no matter how many letters reach that threshold.

Split the input on whitespace into words and set the answer to 0; for each word, reset the counts, count each character after lowercasing it, and mark a hit once any count reaches 3; add one to the answer for each hit word. Print the answer at the end.

explanationEn:
## Approach

For each word, count letter frequencies ignoring case. If some letter has a frequency of at least 3, the word counts as one.

## Proof of correctness

The frequency condition is the same as in the statement, and each word contributes only one boolean count, so each word contributes at most 1; summing over all words gives the answer.

## Complexity

Time O(L), space O(1) for the alphabet.

## Source notes

This site supplied a deterministic standard input/output protocol. In upstream problem 9, the dense-arrival example omitted the completion time of one admitted guest; this site corrected it to 3301 according to the explicit 300-second service and queue rules, and states this truthfully in the source evidence.
